hints.title: One-Dimensional Point Absolute Delta Minima
hints.text: Compute the absolute difference between all pairs of distinct point locations and take the minimum.

hints.title: Distinct Point Pair Inequality Join
hints.text: Join table with itself on p1.x < p2.x to compare each unique pair of points exactly once, then take min(p2.x - p1.x).

hints.title: Shortest Distance Blueprint
hints.text: select min(p2.x - p1.x) as shortest from Point p1 join Point p2 on p1.x < p2.x.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT MIN(p2.x - p1.x) AS shortest
FROM Point p1
JOIN Point p2 ON p1.x < p2.x;
```

variables: N: number of points in Point table
complexity.notes: Pairwise inequality join evaluates all unordered pairs in quadratic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self joining on equality produces zero distance trivial matches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Ordering condition p1.x < p2.x avoids computing absolute value and cuts comparison pairs in half.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of inequality join p1.x < p2.x to avoid redundant calculations.

solutions.approach: Pandas Sort and Adjacent Difference Minima
